verdict.rationale: Missive documents its own building pieces for separating mail: team inboxes and dedicated team spaces give a distinct team stream, and rules (up to 1000) can apply labels to conversations, as in the label-at-24-hours escalation example. Labels can also be searched in the command bar. There is no documented split-inbox or focused-streams feature that automatically buckets important, newsletters, and calendar invites for priority-ordered triage. missing for 10: a documented split or priority inbox view, built-in categorization of important/newsletters/calendar invites, triage ordering by priority rather than arrival, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
